answer_1.quote: Writing Ability. Writing, one of the most frequently used LLM function, plays a vital role... We select challenging writing instructions, which require not only an excellent mastering of language but also a high level of instruction-following, consistency, and creativity.

answer_2.quote: ALIGNBENCH distinctively leverages GPT-4 as the major evaluator to analyze and subsequently grade the responses... point-wise grading with Chain-of-Thought and rule‑calibrated scoring provides automatic, scalable evaluation.

answer_3.quote: ALIGN‑BENCH distinctly leverages GPT-4 as the major model evaluator... adopts point‑wise grading with Chain‑of‑Thought explanations and rule‑calibrated multi‑dimensional scoring.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a comprehensive human annotation experiment... human annotators are tasked with assigning quality ratings to the answers according to the references.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assign a quality rating on a scale from 1 to 5 indicating response quality relative to the reference answer.
